description.value: The Yoho National Park Visitor Centre is the primary information hub for Yoho National Park, situated along the Trans-Canada Highway in Field, B.C. on the western slopes of the Great Divide. The centre is the gateway to one of Canada's most spectacular mountain parks, home to the UNESCO World Heritage Burgess Shale fossil sites, Lake O'Hara, and a network of trails through glacier-carved peaks and waterfalls. Touring cyclists crossing the Rockies on the Trans-Canada will find it an essential stop for current trail conditions, wildlife advisories, and park regulations.
